rules.name: ZeroAsyncVoid
rules.description: Never write async void methods. Use async Task with [RelayCommand] or Task.Run.

rules.name: NoCrossThreadUIMutation
rules.description: Never mutate [ObservableProperty] or collections inside Task.Run. Marshall via IDispatcherService or await.

rules.name: GracefulCancellation
rules.description: Catch OperationCanceledException before generic Exception. Handle user cancel cleanly.

rules.name: SafeWinRTInterop
rules.description: Never instantiate FileOpenPicker or Clipboard directly. Inject IFilePickerService and IClipboardService with HWND binding.

rules.name: SafeConverterBackwards
rules.description: Never throw NotImplementedException in IValueConverter.ConvertBack; return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue.
